purpose: Test the untried H2 combination of direct Brier regression, compact row-local hierarchical state, and monotonic state constraints.

novelty_audit.v4_player_state: Ridge residual correction over a frozen M3 prediction; no direct Brier model or monotonic constraint
novelty_audit.v5_dynamic_state: CatBoost RMSE residual around a state base; no monotonic constraint
novelty_audit.existing_lightgbm: binary classification or temporal residual models; no direct compact state Brier model with monotone constraints

data_rules.history_rule: all labels and frozen entity states use seasons strictly before the target year
data_rules.state_rule: current row official cumulative counters minus entity state frozen before that row season

fixed_estimator.objective: regression_l2 (exact Brier loss for binary labels)

structural_ablation.parent: same fixed direct-Brier LightGBM on official base columns, excluding pitcher_id and batter_id
structural_ablation.candidate: exact parent plus a fixed 16-column hierarchical pitcher/batter current-state block

hierarchical_priors.league_prior: mean R target from at most the latest three completed seasons

candidate_features: pitcher and batter state uncertainty proxies

development_gate.uncertainty: pitcher-cluster bootstrap 95% interval with 1000 fixed-seed replicates
requirements: positive R point gain over exact direct-Brier parent in both 2022 and 2023
positive R 95% gain lower bound over exact direct-Brier parent in both 2022 and 2023
positive R point gain over exact C and both honest R anchors in both 2022 and 2023
development_gate.on_pass: freeze the exact recipe and run 2024 once
